title: Governance rule (authored)
description: A portable, authored deterministic rule. Layer A is a mechanical predicate (capability + resource + optional pattern) that blocks/redacts an action; Layer B is context-as-steering, GENERATED from Layer A so it never bluffs. Rules are authored once and compiled per-runtime to hooks. Determinism/coverage labels are emitted by the compiler per runtime (see hook-capability-matrix), not authored here. The runtime result of evaluating a rule is a policy-decision record.

id.description: Stable human-readable rule id, e.g. protect-shared-branch.

intent.description: Plain-language statement of what the rule protects. The human-maintainable summary the GUI shows.

match.description: Layer A predicate. Prefer capability + resource (normalization-clean YES/NO); use pattern only when unavoidable.

capability.description: Canonical capabilities the rule governs, e.g. git.branch_change, filesystem.read, network.egress. The compiler expands each to EVERY known tool that reaches the effect (no per-tool matcher).

resource.description: Resource selector, e.g. branch:main, path:/etc/*, host:*.internal, db:production. Null = any.

pattern.description: Optional regex predicate over tool_input (the raw grep). Best-effort on polymorphic shell; prefer capability+resource. Present here honestly as the escape hatch, not the default.

condition.description: Optional session condition, e.g. active_backend:cloud (the 'PII stays local' case), classification:personal-data.

action.description: observe = log only (track); ask = block until a human confirms (blocking approval); redact = rewrite ingress before the model sees it; deny = block the action (enforce); allow = explicit allow/exception for precedence. Maps to policy-decision.decision at runtime.

reason.description: Reactive Layer B: the denial reason the agent sees. Generated from the rule if null; may be overridden. MUST be true (no bluffing) — it is only shown because Layer A actually enforces.

backstop.description: Outcome-guarantee hardening. The non-bypassable seam that makes the NO hold for structural gaps the hook alone cannot cover. 'none' = evaluation-deterministic but not outcome-guaranteed (declare it).

fail_mode.description: What the shim does on its own error/timeout. Deterministic gates want 'closed' (block); purely observational rules may be 'open'. The compiler must not silently emit 'open' for a deny rule without labeling it.

steer.description: Proactive Layer B: inject this rule into agent context (SessionStart rail) as an enforced, immutable rule, so a cooperating agent stops hunting for gaps. Only legitimate because Layer A really enforces it.

steer_text.description: Override for the injected steering line; generated from the rule if null. NO BLUFFING: only assert controls that are mechanically enforced. Generated text is derived from the compiled rule set so it is automatically true.

scope.description: Where the rule applies and travels. repository = committed .control-plane rules (per-repo, per-team); user = personal; organization = signed policy bundle. This is the 'across environments' distribution axis.

runtimes.description: Limit to specific runtimes, or null = all. The compiler emits per-runtime coverage (enforced / partial / unsupported) regardless.
